text: I saw ice forming on the mirrors on the county road at 23:10 last night. Station said 36.
That matches a shaded-cut delta: the cut runs colder than the station. What did the surface look like at the creek, and did the spray off the tires go quiet?
Spray went quiet. I slowed to 25.
Then the surface was at or below freezing there. Hold the 25 through the cut and no brake on the bridge deck.
